title: Velvety Glazed Uruguayan Wagyu Skewers
description: A cultured Uruguayan dish featuring tender Wagyu beef, a sweet and sticky glaze, and a side of roasted vegetables, perfect for a date night, and can be adapted to be vegetarian friendly by substituting the Wagyu with portobello mushrooms.

ingredients.name: Wagyu beef
ingredients.notes: or portobello mushrooms for vegetarian option

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, or 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, honey, soy sauce, and balsamic vinegar to make the glaze.
Thread the Wagyu beef and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the glaze onto both sides of the beef and vegetables.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley and a side of roasted vegetables.
Roast the vegetables in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
For a vegetarian option, substitute the Wagyu beef with portobello mushrooms and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until tender.
